counting_rule: Only public, non-owner, permissioned, redacted GitHub evidence can unlock external users, feedback, AI reviews, business validation, real-model runs, or GitHub-star resume claims. Page views, self-authored planning issues, private replies, and outreach attempts are not counted.
next_resume_unlocks: 1 non-owner public GitHub issue confirming a reproducible run
1 non-owner AI/ML reviewer issue validating the agent design
1 redacted business-data replay issue with permission to count evidence
1 organic public star or fork from someone who found the repo useful
not_claimed: No confirmed external users are claimed.
No external customer or business feedback is claimed.
No enterprise deployment, production usage, or measured company impact is claimed.
No GitHub stars beyond the live public count are claimed.
